    2. Gildan

      For 40 years, Gildan has been a trusted leader in the apparel industry, delivering high-quality and durability in every garment. From versatile adult styles, to women and youth collections, the Brand’s commitment to excellence is evident through their production of durable materials and attention to detail. From classic T-Shirts to soft hoodies, Gildan ensures that each piece is crafted with comfort, style and durability.

    3. What makes our products unique?

      At Gildan we source our cotton, spin yarn, knit dye and craft garments with care for the earth and its sustainability. Choose Gildan for fashion that feels good and does good.

      Products for Every ‘Body’

      Gildan offers affordable, stylish apparel for all sizes, great for fashion lovers and DIYers. Explore a rainbow of T-Shirts and Hoodies to fit every personality.

      How are our products sustainable?

      They feature responsibly sourced cotton, recycled polyester, water recycling, and renewable energy. Each garment reflects Gildan’s commitment to quality and sustainability.

    Product Description

    Whether wearing it for work or play, the Gildan Ultra Cotton Adult T-Shirt is a wardrobe basic that works for just about any occasion. It features a classic fit and a heavyweight fabric with taped neck and shoulders for comfort and durability. You can decorate using screen printing, DTG, heat transfers, dye sublimation or discharge, and companion styles for youth and toddlers make it easy to create matching outfits for the whole family.

    Church of Christ BB17047, Barbados

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    • ChatBot
      4.0 out of 5 stars Good buy with some things to note below.
      Reviewed in the United States on February 11, 2026
      Size: MediumColor: BlackNumber of Items: 2Verified Purchase
      Fitment is spot on if not 1-2 millimeters slim in the chest and collar; I’m 5’6” 140lbs with a 14 1/2” neck. The length is perfect for tucking and leaving untucked. The shirt doesn’t stretch like those with synthetic blends which also means it doesn’t have unnatural softness blends do. This could be a negative to some and I considered it momentarily, until I felt the heat dissipating from my body. This shirt breaths so wonderfully. The color is a brilliant black but it collects everything it brushes against an given the color it is all highly visible. I don’t use fabric softeners but those may help with all the aforementioned. We will see how the color holds up and how the fabric resists thinning. The lack of softness is in part because the shirt is somewhat thick but remains breathable.

      If you’re looking for something natural for a change, grab this, do consider buying a size up or trying which fits best and consider a lighter color.

    • Brooklyn
      5.0 out of 5 stars Great shirts for Cricut projects and family gifts
      Reviewed in the United States on January 24, 2026
      Size: X-LargeColor: BlackNumber of Items: 2Verified Purchase
      I bought these shirts to make custom Christmas shirts for my family using my Cricut, and they worked really well for that purpose. The fabric is thick and sturdy, which made applying HTV vinyl easy and stress-free.
      The shirts held their shape while pressing, and the vinyl adhered smoothly without scorching or warping. After washing, the shirts still look good and the designs stayed intact with no peeling so far.

      Pros:
      Thick, durable cotton that presses well
      Smooth surface for HTV and iron-on designs
      True to size and consistent across the multipack
      Great value if you’re making multiple shirts
      Cons:
      Fabric is heavier than fashion tees, so it’s not super lightweight
      Slight stiffness at first, but it softens after washing
      Overall, these are a solid choice if you’re making custom shirts for events, holidays, or gifts—especially with a Cricut. I’d definitely buy them again for future projects.
